configuration: Exploratory Release optimization with DEBUG-gated mocks and local package coverage instrumentation; supplemented by matched coverage-free mock idle samples. Not production integration qualification.

environment.hardware: MacBook Air Mac16,12; Apple M4; 10 CPU cores; 16 GiB

limitations: Single 20-second windows; other development processes were active.
Mock services exclude real Apple Events, camera, EventKit, Clipboard polling and Core Audio taps.
Playback samples began on expanded Home; continuous shell state was not logged. Later final observation was collapsed, so comparisons do not prove steady expanded performance.
RSS reflects memory pressure and residency; no optimization or leak conclusion follows from these two runs.
coverage_free_idle_method: Both binaries rebuilt with existing release-policy global coverage-disable flags. DEBUG-gated mocks explicitly enabled. Verified command lines; five-second warmup; simultaneous 20-second windows; no Computer Use calls; real adapters excluded.
